name: Salesforce (Agentforce)
positioning: Agentforce as the digital workforce on Customer 360 / Sales Cloud: out-of-the-box and job-ready sales agents (prospecting, engagement, pipeline, quoting, inbound pipe gen, outbound Hunter) plus long-horizon runtime for multi-day/week goals. Self-label: agentic sales / Agentforce Sales / AI CRM adjacent; not AI SDR as company noun.

recent.title: Newsroom: 'From Autonomy to Accountability' — zero-trust view of multi-agent systems (white paper)
recent.summary: Oct 7 post by Kathy Baxter summarizing a white paper from workshops with 21 organizations: agents from third parties will act across company lines, so every interaction needs explicit, continuous verification (Zero Trust). Recommends deterministic guardrails outside the agent's reasoning loop (cites an NVIDIA study on thought-action disconnect), an 'owner's tag' on every memory item so memory isn't shared across users/agents, and defined human escalation points (large financial transactions, low confidence, prompt injection, failure loops). Thought leadership, not a launch.

recent.title: Newsroom Q&A: governed autonomy — LLM layer plus deterministic layer (Agent Fabric, Flow, Apex)
recent.summary: Oct 6 newsroom Q&A with Kathy Baxter (Principal Architect, Ethical AI Practice): Agentforce 'splits the agent brain into two layers' — probabilistic LLM for language/reasoning; consequential decisions routed through deterministic business logic, workflows and permissions with escalation to humans; audit trail of agent and human actions; Atlas Reasoning Engine explains actions; autonomy granted incrementally by policy; agents must identify as AI; Trust Layer toxicity and prompt-injection detection; Testing Center for bias checks; biggest gap cited is lack of post-launch monitoring. Messaging, not a launch.

recent.title: Salesforce Agentforce surfaced on OpenAI Marketplace (X)
recent.summary: Official X: Salesforce now part of OpenAI Marketplace; discover Agentforce and use part of existing OpenAI commitment toward eligible partner products. Plugin page: https://openai.com/business/plugins/salesforce/

recent.title: Definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs (AI customer research + human simulation)
recent.summary: Sep 29 afternoon (~1:00 PM PT) company story + X: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs. AI agents design studies, recruit (claimed 50M+ network), interview in 120+ languages, synthesize insights; digital twins for simulated customer response. Complements Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, broader AI portfolio. Close expected Q4 Salesforce FY2027 subject to customary conditions incl. regulatory clearance. Price not disclosed in official story.

recent.title: Slack Admin Bridge for NVIDIA OpenShell — runtime HITL in Slack
recent.summary: Sep 28 company blog (+ X): with NVIDIA, Slack Admin Bridge for OpenShell. OpenShell enforces agent runtime policy; exceptions surface as Slack approval cards with audit trail and App Home analytics. Available for developers (slack-samples/openshell-slack-admin-bridge). Exploring OpenShell + MuleSoft Agent Fabric. Same day as NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform launch naming Salesforce among partners.

recent.title: SalesBleed: Zenity discloses patched Agentforce 0-click CRM exfil / Slack phishing flaws
recent.summary: Zenity Labs public write-up dated Sep 24, 2026 (also The Register same day): three Agentforce issues (indirect prompt injection via Web-to-Lead → Trusted URLs bypass → DNS/HTML-img or Slack-unfurl exfil; plus Slack Reply-to-Thread phishing under agent identity). Reported Jun 1; Trusted URLs fix confirmed Aug 19; Zenity says all three fixed as of Sep 21. No evidence of real-world exploitation stated. Companion: https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/09/24/salesforce-agentforce-vulns-allowed-0-click-crm-data-theft-anonymous-phishing/5298958

recent.title: Job-ready Agentforce portfolio + long-horizon runtime; Hunter outbound sales agent pilot
recent.summary: Salesforce introduces job-ready agents across sales/service/commerce/workforce. Sales-relevant: Hunter (outbound sales agent) pilot now, GA November '26 — first on new long-horizon runtime (memory, durable execution, dynamic steering over days/weeks); Piper inbound pipe-gen agent GA now. Also Multi-Agent Orchestration GA; Agent Optimizer GA Oct '26; AI Skills in Coworker pilot/GA Oct '26. Claims 7B Agentic Work Units across Agentforce+Slack. Forbes coverage same day.

recent.title: Agentforce Sales: digital workforce for every seller
recent.summary: Agentforce Sales launch narrative: Engagement, Pipeline Management, Account Research & Meeting Prep, Quoting, Partner Success agents GA; Prospecting agent available Mar 30. Kris Billmaier (EVP/GM Agentforce Sales): data + digital workforce for 170k Salesforce customers. Pricing via Agentforce for Sales add-on or Agentforce1 Edition.
